fields.meta_title: Automotive Survey Builder for Dealers and Shops | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build an automotive survey for car sales, service visits, test drives, and shop hours, with every answer saved to a database you own.
fields.h1: Build an Automotive Survey for Car Sales and Service
fields.hero_description: Build an automotive survey that rates every step of a sale or repair visit and saves each answer to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What Emergent Builds Into an Automotive Survey
fields.features_subheading: One prompt builds the survey and the table its answers land in. Another prompt changes either before the next customer sees it.
fields.feature_1:
A rating for each step of the sale

Name the steps a buyer goes through, such as the test drive, trade-in appraisal, paperwork, and delivery. Emergent drafts a 1 to 5 rating for each, and a prompt rewords any.
fields.feature_2:
Sent when the deal or repair order closes

The app reads delivered deals and closed repair orders from your dealer management system through its API, then sends each customer the survey that matches the visit.
fields.feature_3:
Repair order and VIN on every answer

Each response is a row in a database you own, tagged with the repair order number, VIN, and advisor. Filter by advisor, or compare this quarter's scores with the last one.
fields.feature_4:
Low scores emailed to the right manager

Pick the score that needs a reply, such as anything under 3, and who handles it. The app emails that manager the customer's name, the repair order number, and the comment.
fields.feature_5:
One question per screen on a phone

Customers answer one question per screen on a phone, in the waiting room or at home that night. Emergent puts no cap on responses, so every buyer and service visit counts.
fields.feature_6:
Your domain, and the code on GitHub

Run the survey on your own domain, included in Emergent and billed in credits. On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository and keep it with your other tools.

fields.tab_content_1:
The paperwork wait, named by 27 of 68 buyers

Ravenmoor Motors sends its survey 3 days after each delivery and rates four steps of the sale. Of 104 buyers that month, 68 answered, and 27 of the 68 named the paperwork wait the worst step. Sales manager Merritt Vallencourt now starts the paperwork while the car is being detailed.
fields.tab_content_2:
Repair order 58214 scored 2, and the service manager called

When a repair order closes at Dunlivet Motors, the customer gets a short survey. A score of 1 or 2 out of 5 emails service manager Corentin Orloff. Vesna Saarinen scored repair order 58214 a 2 because the brake squeal came back, and Corentin called her and booked a recheck for the next morning.
fields.tab_content_3:
Low trade-in offers lost 17 of 41 shoppers

Thornecastle Auto Group follows up with shoppers who test drove and did not buy within 14 days, asking for one reason per shopper. Of 130 shoppers, 41 answered, and 17 of the 41 said the trade-in offer was too low. Sales director Leopold Lundqvist now walks every shopper through the appraisal sheet.
fields.tab_content_4:
Saturday mornings beat evening pickup in a 212-vote poll

Copperwhistle Auto Repair asked its customers before changing its hours. The poll went to 590 customers, and 212 answered: 131 picked Saturday mornings, 58 picked evening pickup, and 23 wanted no change. Owner Oriel Hastrup now opens the shop on Saturdays from 8 to noon.

fields.howto_title: How to Run an Automotive Survey
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to run an automotive survey that customers finish on a phone and that sends each low score to a manager.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Pick the moment you want to measure
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Rate each step on one scale
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Send it while the visit is recent
fields.howto_step_1_des: Choose one moment per survey: a vehicle delivery, a service visit, or a test drive that did not end in a sale. Each one needs different questions. Put the moment in your prompt, and Emergent drafts a survey that fits it.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Use the same 1 to 5 scale for every step. Then the paperwork score and the delivery score sit on one chart. After the ratings, ask which step was worst. That one answer tells a manager where to look first.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Send the sales survey a few days after delivery, once the buyer has driven the car at home. Send the service survey when the repair order closes. The customer then answers about this visit, not the one before it.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Keep each survey under 10 questions, short enough to finish in the service waiting room. Ask only about the visit in front of you. Save questions about their next car or how they drive for a separate survey.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Tag each answer with its record
fields.howto_step_5_des: Decide which record each answer carries before launch: the repair order or VIN, plus the advisor or salesperson. With those attached, comments become a query, such as every low score for one advisor this month.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Name who hears about a low score
fields.howto_step_6_des: Name one person for each kind of problem. A complaint about a repair goes to the service manager, and a complaint about the sale goes to the sales manager. Agree on how fast they reply, such as the next business day.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Test it in one department first
fields.howto_step_7_des: Run the survey in the service department for two weeks before adding sales. Read the answers as they arrive and reword any question customers skip. Then turn on the sales survey and the test drive follow-up.

faq_plan.a: An automotive survey is a set of questions a dealership or repair shop sends customers about buying a car, having it repaired, or taking a test drive. Each answer rates one part of the visit, and the totals show which step of a sale or a repair needs work.

faq_plan.q: How do I create an automotive survey?
faq_plan.a: Describe the survey in a prompt to Emergent's AI survey builder: the visit it covers, the steps to rate, and who should hear about a low score. Emergent builds the survey and the database behind it. A follow-up prompt changes a question or adds a branch before the first customer answers.

faq_plan.q: Which questions belong in an automotive survey after a sale?
faq_plan.a: Ask whether the final price matched the quote, whether someone showed the buyer the controls at delivery, and what nearly stopped the deal. Those car survey questions catch what a rating per step misses. Then add the Net Promoter question: how likely the buyer is to recommend you, on a zero-to-ten scale. That one number is easy to track month to month.

faq_plan.q: How do I get more customers to finish an automotive survey?
faq_plan.a: Start with the easiest question and leave typing for last. A one-tap rating, like the quick picks in game survey questions, gets a customer moving. Put the comment box at the end. A customer who stops early has then still left a score. Then cut any question that half your customers skip.

faq_plan.q: Should an automotive survey be anonymous?
faq_plan.a: Not for service follow-ups. A survey tied to the repair order lets the service manager call a customer about a bad repair. For questions about staff, such as how an advisor treated them, offer an anonymous version and say so in the invitation. Emergent builds either kind from a prompt, and the answers stay in a database you own.

faq_plan.q: How do I compare automotive survey scores across dealership locations?
faq_plan.a: Tag every answer with the store it came from, and ask the same questions at every location, or the scores will not line up. The app can show a live dashboard with one row per store. A prompt adds a filter for one advisor or one month.

faq_plan.q: Can an automotive survey reach people who have not bought from my dealership yet?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Send a short survey to sales leads asking what they drive now, when they plan to replace it, and what matters most in the next car. With no visit to rate, it works more like audience survey questions than a customer survey. Keep it to five or six questions.

faq_plan.q: What should an automotive survey ask after a repair?
faq_plan.a: Ask whether the work finished when promised and whether the final bill matched the estimate, then ask for a comment. A no to either question is worth a call from the service manager, even when the overall rating looks fine.

faq_plan.q: How often should a dealership run an automotive survey?
faq_plan.a: Run sales and service surveys after every delivery and every closed repair order, not on a calendar. Each answer then has a visit attached. Save yearly surveys for bigger questions, such as adding a second location. With no response cap in Emergent, a busy service lane can survey every visit.

faq_plan.q: Can an automotive survey collect feedback from my service technicians?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Send technicians and advisors a separate survey after training or at the end of each quarter, asking about their tools and which jobs need more training. For a course-by-course format, borrow from learning and development survey questions. Keep it apart from the customer survey, and the two sets of scores never mix.
